cohort: Children born in Ontario, Canada between 1995-2018 to women with schizophrenia (n=5066) compared to unexposed children (n=2,939,320).
finding: Children born to women with schizophrenia have a higher risk of developing a Complex Chronic Condition (aHR 1.25, 95% CI 1.10-1.41) compared to unexposed children.
gest_age: Term and preterm infants were included and analysed separately.
